capabilities: Import Xiaohongshu notes from share text or note URLs
Download note images into the vault and write Markdown image links
Save videos as remote links instead of downloading them
Configure default note and image folders
Configure frontmatter fields with order, enable state, defaults, and placeholders
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README; parsing depends on Xiaohongshu's current page structure and may break if the site changes; author solicits coffee donations.
intentEvidence: This plugin is adapted from the original xiaohongshu-importer plugin by bnchiang96.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Xiaohongshu share text or note URLs into Markdown notes with downloaded images and structured metadata.

relations.evidence: This plugin is adapted from the original xiaohongshu-importer plugin by bnchiang96.

summary: Import plugin that saves Xiaohongshu (小红书) notes into a vault with configurable folders, frontmatter fields, and local image downloads.
